$comment: Path→doc mapping read by doc-reminders.mjs (PostToolUse hook). `pattern` is a JS regex tested against the repo-relative path (forward slashes). `tools`: 'edit' fires only on Edit/Write; 'any' also fires on Read/Grep/Glob. Each rule injects its `docs` lines into context at most once per session. Per-directory traps belong in that directory's AGENTS.md (auto-loaded), not here — this map is only for docs that path proximity alone won't surface.
